resources.string: Termux is not installed. Please install Termux from F-Droid first.
Failed to connect to Workspace server. Make sure RUN_COMMAND permission is granted and allow-external-apps=true is in ~/.termux/termux.properties.

Termux Workspace requires the "Run commands in Termux environment" permission to start the Termux server in the background automatically.

Quick steps:
1. Tap "Open Settings" below
2. Open "Permissions"
3. Open "Additional permissions"
4. Enable "Run commands in Termux environment"
